Name: Keturah
Summary: Keturah was the wife Abraham married after Sarah's death, and the mother of six sons.
KeyStory: Keturah's sons received gifts from Abraham and were sent eastward, while Isaac received the inheritance.
RelatedPeople: Abraham; Isaac; Zimran; Jokshan; Medan; Midian; Ishbak; Shuah, Son of Keturah
LifeLesson: God's promises continued through Isaac, while still providing for Abraham's whole household.
